title: System health
description: Is the system healthy right now? Panels are added as build steps finish (tech/stack-and-build-guide.md, UIs).

panels.title: Bluesky lag
panels.description: now() minus Jetstream's time for the last event processed. Alert at 1 hour; Jetstream keeps 36 hours.

targets.rawSql: SELECT lag_seconds FROM monitoring.collector_lag WHERE collector = 'bluesky'

panels.title: Posts in the last 24 hours
panels.description: Live posts received (replays excluded), by source.

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, sum(posts) AS posts FROM monitoring.posts_per_hour WHERE hour > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY source ORDER BY source

panels.title: Failed jobs in the last 24 hours

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS failed FROM monitoring.job_runs WHERE status = 'failed' AND started_at > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: Gaps in the stream (all time)
panels.description: Spans Jetstream could not replay (cursor older than its 36-hour window). These posts are lost.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS gaps, coalesce(sum(gap_seconds), 0) AS lost_seconds FROM monitoring.collector_gaps

panels.title: Posts per hour, by source
panels.description: Live posts by reception time (UTC). An empty hour from a normally active source raises an alert.

targets.rawSql: SELECT hour AS time, source AS metric, posts AS value FROM monitoring.posts_per_hour WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Collector lag
panels.description: last_event_at is how far each collector has caught up: Jetstream's own time for Bluesky, the last successful poll for pollers, the close of the last stored candle for Binance.

targets.rawSql: SELECT collector, source, lag_seconds, heartbeat_age_seconds, last_event_at FROM monitoring.collector_lag ORDER BY source, collector

panels.title: Job runs per hour, by status

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', started_at) AS time, status AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM monitoring.job_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT started_at, job, status, duration_seconds, run_id, error FROM monitoring.job_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Raw store by dataset, last 7 days

targets.rawSql: SELECT dataset, partition_date, files, rows, bytes, last_written_at FROM monitoring.raw_store WHERE partition_date > current_date - 7 ORDER BY partition_date DESC, dataset

panels.title: Deletions synced, by day
panels.description: Posts deleted at the source: found in the stream or by the daily sweep, then purged from the raw files.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day, source, method, deleted, purged FROM monitoring.deletions_per_day ORDER BY day DESC, source, method LIMIT 60
SELECT collector, gap_start, gap_end, gap_seconds, detected_at FROM monitoring.collector_gaps ORDER BY gap_start DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Last chain check
panels.description: The daily job recomputes every hash and link, and checks every anchor sent to the advisor. A break is also written to the ledger as a violation.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN ok THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS intact FROM monitoring.ledger_checks ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Hours since the last check
panels.description: Runs daily at 05:45 UTC. Alert past 26 hours.

targets.rawSql: SELECT age_hours FROM monitoring.ledger_checks ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Ledger entries
panels.description: Entries in the hash chain, all tables and phases.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(entries), 0) AS entries FROM monitoring.ledger_entries

panels.title: Protocol violations, last 7 days
panels.description: Late predictions rejected by the database clock, chain breaks and permission denials (Quadro 9).

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(violations), 0) AS violations FROM monitoring.ledger_violations WHERE day > now() - interval '7 days'

panels.title: Ledger entries by table and phase

targets.rawSql: SELECT table_name, phase, entries, last_recorded_at FROM monitoring.ledger_entries ORDER BY table_name, phase
SELECT checked_at, ok, entries, head_seq, anchors_checked, problems FROM monitoring.ledger_checks ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Normalization backlog
panels.description: Raw posts not yet normalized (runs every 10 minutes). Alert when the oldest is 2 hours old.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pending FROM monitoring.normalize_backlog

panels.title: Oldest pending post
panels.description: Age of the oldest raw post still waiting for normalization.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(extract(epoch FROM now() - oldest_pending), 0) AS age FROM monitoring.normalize_backlog

panels.title: Kept for the study, last 24 hours
panels.description: English, not spam, not a duplicate, live.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(in_study), 0) AS in_study FROM monitoring.normalized_per_hour WHERE hour > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: Share kept, last 24 hours
panels.description: Posts kept for the study over all posts normalized.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * sum(in_study) / nullif(sum(posts), 0) AS kept_pct FROM monitoring.normalized_per_hour WHERE hour > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: Posts per hour: normalized, English, kept

targets.rawSql: SELECT hour AS time, sum(posts) AS normalized, sum(english) AS english, sum(in_study) AS kept FROM monitoring.normalized_per_hour WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) GROUP BY hour ORDER BY 1

SELECT source, sum(posts) AS posts, 100.0 * sum(english) / nullif(sum(posts), 0) AS english_pct, 100.0 * sum(spam) / nullif(sum(posts), 0) AS spam_pct, 100.0 * sum(exact_duplicates) / nullif(sum(posts), 0) AS exact_dup_pct, 100.0 * sum(near_duplicates) / nullif(sum(posts), 0) AS near_dup_pct, 100.0 * sum(in_study) / nullif(sum(posts), 0) AS kept_pct FROM monitoring.normalized_per_hour WHERE hour > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY source ORDER BY source
SELECT rule, source, sum(posts) AS posts FROM monitoring.spam_rules_per_day WHERE day > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY rule, source ORDER BY posts DESC

panels.title: Forecasts on time, last 24 hours
panels.description: Forecasts in the ledger before their bar opened, all phases. The loop runs at minute 25 only while CRYPTONLP_FORECAST_LOOP is true (smoke runs, pilot, confirmatory period).

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(on_time), 0) AS on_time FROM monitoring.forecast_bars WHERE bar_open > now() - interval '24 hours'

panels.title: Late forecasts, last 7 days
panels.description: Forecasts the database clock refused because they arrived at or after their bar opened. Each is kept as a violation in the ledger.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(late), 0) AS late FROM monitoring.forecast_bars WHERE bar_open > now() - interval '7 days'

panels.title: Bars missed, last 24 hours
panels.description: Hours with no on-time forecast since the first forecast of the last 24 hours. Smoke run 1 passes with 0 over 24 hours. After the loop is switched off, the count grows until its last forecast leaves the window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS missed FROM generate_series(date_trunc('hour', now()) - interval '23 hours', date_trunc('hour', now()), interval '1 hour') AS b(bar_open) WHERE b.bar_open >= (SELECT min(bar_open) FROM monitoring.forecast_bars WHERE bar_open > now() - interval '24 hours') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM monitoring.forecast_bars f WHERE f.bar_open = b.bar_open AND f.on_time > 0)

panels.title: Due but not scored
panels.description: Forecasts whose bar has closed but have no score yet. The loop scores at minute 25, so up to one per asset is normal for 25 minutes; more means missing candles or a stopped loop.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(pending), 0) AS pending FROM monitoring.forecast_bars

panels.title: Forecasts per bar: on time, late, scored, pending
panels.description: Per bar the forecasts are about (UTC), all phases.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bar_open AS time, sum(on_time) AS on_time, sum(late) AS late, sum(scored) AS scored, sum(pending) AS pending FROM monitoring.forecast_bars WHERE $__timeFilter(bar_open) GROUP BY bar_open ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Posts per bar in the features, by asset
panels.description: In-study posts mentioning each asset, per final bar (stub labels until SemIf, step 6).

targets.rawSql: SELECT bar_open AS time, asset || ' (' || classifier_version || ')' AS metric, post_count AS value FROM monitoring.features_per_hour WHERE NOT bot_filtered AND $__timeFilter(bar_open) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Last bar: minutes from close to labeled
panels.description: For the newest fully labeled bar, how long after it closed its last post got a label from the newest classifier version. The loop forecasts at minute 25 of the next hour, so this must stay well under 25.

targets.rawSql: SELECT minutes_after_close AS value FROM monitoring.classify_per_bar WHERE newest AND waiting = 0 AND labeled > 0 ORDER BY bar_open DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Posts waiting for a label, last 24 hours
panels.description: In-study posts received in the last 24 hours (bars already closed) that the newest classifier version has not labeled.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(waiting), 0) AS value FROM monitoring.classify_per_bar WHERE newest AND bar_open > now() - interval '24 hours' AND bar_open + interval '1 hour' < now()

panels.title: SemIf: seconds per 1,000 posts, last 24 hours
panels.description: Classifier wall time per 1,000 posts (nine SemIf decisions each), from clean.classify_batches. The article reports it as latency per thousand posts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 1000 * sum(seconds) / nullif(sum(posts), 0) AS value FROM monitoring.classify_throughput WHERE hour > now() - interval '24 hours' AND model_version LIKE 'semif-%'

panels.title: Posts without an embedding
panels.description: In-study posts with no vector from the embedding model in use (clean.embeddings).

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(sum(waiting), 0) AS value FROM monitoring.embedding_backlog

panels.title: Minutes from bar close to all posts labeled, by classifier
panels.description: Per hourly bar of posts (receive time): when its last post was labeled, in minutes after the bar closed. Negative: labeled while the bar was still open. A full-store backfill shows as very large values for old bars.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bar_open AS time, model_version AS metric, minutes_after_close AS value FROM monitoring.classify_per_bar WHERE $__timeFilter(bar_open) AND labeled > 0 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Classifier throughput: seconds per 1,000 posts
panels.description: Hourly, per classifier version.

targets.rawSql: SELECT hour AS time, model_version AS metric, seconds_per_1000 AS value FROM monitoring.classify_throughput WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) ORDER BY 1
